posts.author: Ayback
posts.body:
I'm Ayback!  I've been dabbling in RPG Maker since RPG Maker 2000 was new, but I don't really have anything to show for it.  My games back then were pretty bad, and I've never actually finished a game!  But I've recently started a new project and I'm hoping I'll be able to see it through this time.
Looking forward to meeting everyone here!
